name: Clouds

# clouds

Cloud texture overlay

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------|-------------|
| seed | int | 1 | 1-100 | Cloud pattern variation |
| scale | float | 0.25 | 0.1-1 | Cloud scale |
| speed | int | 0 | 0-4 | Animation speed |
